given_when_then.given: A Dispute Ticket exists and is linked to an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The Delivery Partner submits a Delivery Proof for the ticket
given_when_then.then: The system associates the Delivery Proof with the Dispute Ticket

given_when_then.given: A Dispute Ticket exists and is linked to an Order Request
given_when_then.when: A Financial Transaction Record is available for the ticket
given_when_then.then: The system associates the Financial Transaction Record with the Dispute Ticket

success_criteria: The Dispute Ticket record must contain a reference to the associated Delivery Proof.
The Dispute Ticket record must contain a reference to the associated Financial Transaction Record.
The Dispute Ticket must retain its link to the original Order Request after association.
